findings.authoritative_rule: Stata [R] regress, printed p. 15: observations with a missing value in one or more model variables are dropped.
evidence: Both frozen cases use validation/commands/reg/data/reg_fixture.csv, which contains no missing values.
validation/commands/reg/oracles/code_audit_oracle.py:40-50 converts all cells to float and does not implement complete-case selection.
tests/test_api.py:50-55 uses a fully observed sample and asserts only n_obs == 100.
tests/test_ols.py:316-322 covers an all-missing error, not partial joint missingness across y and the requested regressors.
findings.consequence: The release-critical estimation-sample rule is not independently exercised, so all downstream quantities are unverified under missingness.
findings.required_action: Add and map an independent partial-missing case or unit test that verifies the common complete-case sample, nobs, parameter ordering, and estimates.

evidence: validation/commands/reg/formula_map.csv:3-20 uses the Stata regress manual as the sole exact reference for every implemented formula.
validation/commands/reg/theory.md:181-190 labels Aitken (1936) and Fisher (1922) as historical primary context and asserts no exact equation or narrower page location from either.
findings.consequence: Exact original mathematical support is not separately traceable from Stata software-compatibility documentation.
findings.required_action: In a newly frozen formula map, add verified exact original-method locations for the claims they support, or identify and justify a distinct authoritative primary mathematical source without inventing historical equation numbers.

decision_reasons: The independent formula oracle aborts on stale manifest and cases hashes before deriving any metric.
The complete-case estimation rule has no independent partially missing test or validation case.
Exact mathematical-source support is not separated from Stata compatibility documentation in the frozen formula map.
The accessible official manual, source code, tests, and source metadata are sufficient to diagnose these frozen-artifact deficiencies, so BLOCKED_ENV does not apply.
